attchmntText: Kopran Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 39000  Shares.
voiceSummary: Kopran Limited has allotted 39000 equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each to eligible employees under the Kopran Employee Stock Option Plan 2023. The shares were issued at an exercise price of Rs. 179 per share on November 19, 2026. This allotment increases the company's paid-up equity share capital from 48326105 shares to 48365105 shares. The total issued share capital rises to Rs. 483651050. The distinct share numbers range from 48328102 to 48367101. The ISIN number is INE082A01010. The shares rank pari passu with existing equity shares. No lock-in period applies to these shares. The Corporate Affairs Committee approved this allotment. The intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.
